We need to produce a JUnit 4 test file with comprehensive test cases covering methods. The scenario: three experts propose one test case each per method, share, etc. But final deliverable: a single test file containing test cases for all methods, including typical use, edge, error scenarios.

We need to write a test class QueryParserTest with imports, using JUnit 4 annotations @Test, expected exceptions, etc. Should test parse method, combinator handling, consumeSubQuery, findElements branches (byId, byClass, byTag, byAttribute, allElements, pseudo selectors, nth-child, etc.), error cases.

We'll need to use jsoup Evaluator objects to verify type. Since we don't have actual Evaluator implementations, we can rely on class names or instanceof.

Assume jsoup library is on classpath.

We'll create helper methods to assert evaluator type.

Test cases:

1. testParseSimpleTag: "div" => Evaluator.Tag with name "div".

2. testParseId: "#myId" => Evaluator.Id with id "myId".

3. testParseClass: ".myClass" => Evaluator.Class.

4. testParseWildcardTag: "*" => Evaluator.AllElements.

5. testParseAttributeExists: "[href]" => Evaluator.Attribute with key "href".

6. testParseAttributeEquals: "[title=example]" => Evaluator.AttributeWithValue.

7. testParseAttributeStartsWith: "[data^=val]" => AttributeStarting.

8. testParsePseudoContains: ":contains(text)" => Evaluator.ContainsText.

9. testParsePseudoContainsOwn: ":containsOwn(text)".

10. testParsePseudoMatches: ":matches(^\\d+$)".

11. testParsePseudoNot: "div:not(.ignore)" => StructuralEvaluator.Not containing Tag evaluator.

12. testParseCombinatorChild: "div > p" => top evaluator is CombiningEvaluator.And with ImmediateParent.

13. testParseCombinatorDescendant: "ul li" => CombiningEvaluator.And with Parent.

14. testParseGroupOr: "a, b" => CombiningEvaluator.Or.

15. testParseNthChild: "li:nth-child(2n+1)" => Evaluator.IsNthChild with a=2,b=1.

16. testParseNthLastOfType: "li:nth-last-of-type(even)" => IsNthLastOfType a=2,b=0.

17. testParseInvalidSelectorThrows: QueryParser.parse("??") expecting SelectorParseException.

18. testParseAttributeInvalidOperator: "[href??]" expecting SelectorParseException.

19. testConsumeSubQueryComplex: "div[attr='[test]'] > span" ensure subquery parsed correctly.

Edge cases: empty query? parse("") maybe throws? In jsoup likely throws.

Test whitespace handling.

We'll also test combinator starting with combinator: "> p" which should treat root.

Implement test using assertTrue with instanceof.
